questions.fact: A dormouse can spend six months or more asleep, which is how it got a name from the French for sleep.

questions.prompt: Which of these sculptures are by Michelangelo?
questions.fact: Michelangelo carved David from a block of marble that another sculptor had given up on.

questions.prompt: How high is the top Olympic diving platform, in metres?
questions.fact: Ten metres, and a diver hits the water at about 50 km/h.

questions.prompt: How many eyes does a spider usually have?
questions.fact: Most spiders have eight, though many see poorly and feel their way by vibration.

questions.prompt: What is the main ingredient of hummus?
questions.hint: They are also used to make falafel.
questions.fact: Hummus is simply the Arabic word for chickpeas.

questions.prompt: Which was Daniel Craig's first James Bond film?
questions.hint: It was based on the very first Bond novel.
questions.fact: Casino Royale (2006) went back to Ian Fleming's first book, from 1953.
